looms.title: Boosting Leads With High Converting Landing Pages
looms.summary: This Loom reviews a client landing page for Oakland Electricians and Electric Contractors in the Bay Area, focusing on how to increase leads from the residential lighting control page. The reviewer recommends segmenting by service (for example, lighting control for homeowners) and improving conversion elements such as a stronger, centered headline with an eyebrow, clearer body text, stock image replacement, and moving reviews closer to the primary call to action. They note that responding to leads within five minutes can drive a 390% increase in revenue. They also emphasize that SEO improvements and backlinks are slower but important, and they are looking forward to the Monday meeting.
